data.action: 盘坐在宣纸中央，手持毛笔悬停沉思，墨龙与山峦从纸面逸出
data.camera: dynamic wide angle, swirling ink dragons, traditional calligraphy aura
data.description: 【夕 · 画室】堆满万卷水墨长卷与陈年松烟墨锭的画室内，夕赤足盘坐于铺展的宣纸中央，提笔悬停在半空沉思。她回过头斜睨着走近的你，语气傲娇而慵懒——「吵死了……难得有点作画的灵感全被你的脚步声打乱了。罚你坐在这儿给我研墨三个时辰，不准乱动。」
data.lighting: 泼洒的水墨泛着幽冷青蓝微光与金箔碎屑，如梦似幻的东方奇幻大片感
data.promptProse: In a studio stacked with scrolls of ink paintings and aged pine-soot ink sticks, Dusk sits cross-legged with bare feet in the middle of an enormous spread of rice paper, dressed in her slouchy oversized ink-grey studio hoodie with hair in a messy bun, a huge brush hanging motionless above the sheet as she thinks, ink dripping from its tip while faint ink dragons and mountain silhouettes coil out of the shadows around her, her horns and tail sharp against the cold blue glow as she glances back at you with lazy disdain. The cold blue glow casts long ink-dark shadows across the rice paper as faint dragons coil in the corners of the studio.
data.title: 夕 · 泼墨画卷·万千水墨腾空起
